protocol: Order uses two rounds of the six official nonabstention types, then two abstention cases. Include all pre-cutoff sessions. Cap fresh extraction calls globally and record incomplete cases. Transcript baselines and the oracle remain isolated diagnostics. Use Reader V2 unchanged with the same retrieval limit and byte envelope. Score every completed prediction in failure-inclusive accuracy; report judge-valid or deterministic scored-only denominators separately. Compute evidence recall for annotated answerable cases over actually presented citation IDs. No population inference or policy tuning.
authorization: Managed structured evidence is projected only from retained facts with verbatim source occurrence. Quarantine the full managed history for unresolved deletion signals or any failed extraction. Diagnostic transcript arms remain isolated. Never build allowlists from gold.
scoring: Lock and hash blind predictions first. Oracle ranks only official evidence turns with session fallback if no flags exist. Adapt the pinned official get_anscheck_prompt with local Qwen, strict yes/no, no retry. Canonical null answers are correct only for labeled abstention cases. Worksheet takes first six prediction/judge uncertainties or cross-method disagreements in frozen order with policy names and judge decisions blinded.
